## About
VGS Autobody & Details is a small professional full-service auto body shop in St. Louis. We focus on quality and customer service while keeping our pricing competitive.
We use modern technology, professional equipment and premium quality materials, combined with expertise and international experience. Because we are a small independent shop, we can work with your budget to find the best solution for parts and repairs.
Customers rate us 5 on Google from 20 reviews.

## Services
- Complete Collision Repair: Major or minor, body damage or mechanical, we work with professional attention to details to return your vehicle to pre-collision condition.
- Quality Painting: Color matching with or without a factory paint color code, done in our high-tech paint booth with the highest quality paint and materials for a factory quality finish.
- Body Work of Any Complexity: Body work at any complexity level, including repairing and restoring exotic parts. We work with metal, plastic, aluminum, fiberglass and other materials.
- Paintless Dent Removal/Hail Repair: When the original paint is intact, dents can often be repaired without sanding, priming and painting.
- Our Extra Attention to Details: We buff and polish your vehicle from top to bottom.
- Free Estimates: Make an appointment to bring your vehicle in for a free estimate, or send a few pictures for a quick remote estimate.
- Towing Assessment: With our towing partner, we can arrange prompt delivery of your vehicle at competitive rates.

## FAQ
Q: Can I get an estimate from photos?
A: Yes. Send a few pictures using the Estimates by photo option on our website. Remote estimates are approximate only. It is difficult to see the full extent of damage or hidden damage in photos.

Q: Do you help with insurance?
A: Yes. We assist our customers with their insurance companies on collision repairs.

Q: Can you match my paint without a color code?
A: Yes. We match colors with or without a factory paint color code, in our high-tech paint booth.

Q: What materials can you repair?
A: We work with metal, plastic, aluminum, fiberglass and other materials, including exotic parts.
